latest_release.name: v5.1
latest_release.body:
In this release, iOS is broken, we hope to restore it in the future.
You may also want to back up your history due to yet another provider change.
Let's hope this one lasts a little longer.

## What's Changed
* chore: bump homebrew formula by @port19x in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1846
* docs: add instructions for curl-impersonate by @71zenith in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1847
* docs: Enhance doccli entry in README by @TowarzyszFatCat in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1855
* ci: fix ci paths by @port19x in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1860
* fix: detect system-wide flatpak mpv installs by @port19x in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1858
* fix: correct user-level flatpak mpv path (io.mpv.Mpv, not io.mpv/Mpv) by @TigerShark900 in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1863
* feat: support first available episode in ranges by @port19x in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1859
* feat: http error codes upon connection errors by @port19x in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1895
* fix: replace anidb with hianime provider by @U-L-M-S in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1897

## New Contributors
* @TigerShark900 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1863
* @U-L-M-S made their first contribution in https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/pull/1897

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pystardust/ani-cli/compare/v5.0...v5.1
